description: This Java source file defines the class 'EntitySyncContext' within the Apache OFBiz framework, specifically for entity synchronization operations. It manages synchronization context, including timing, transaction, and data collection for entity synchronization processes, supporting both push and pull mechanisms, and interacts with services to log and update synchronization status.

classes.name: EntitySyncContext
classes.description: Manages the context for entity synchronization within OFBiz, including timing, transaction management, data collection, and status updates to facilitate entity data synchronization during push or pull operations.

methods.name: EntitySyncContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the synchronization context by loading configuration, setting timing windows, and preparing entity models based on the entity sync record.

methods.name: isEntitySyncRunning
methods.description: Checks whether the entity synchronization process is currently marked as running, considering last update time and status.

methods.name: hasMoreTimeToSync
methods.description: Determines if the current sync window has remaining time for execution.

methods.name: setCurrentRunEndTime
methods.description: Calculates and sets the end timestamp for the current synchronization run based on split interval.

methods.name: getNextRunEndTime
methods.description: Computes the next end time for the current run, constrained by the overall sync end timestamp.

methods.name: advanceRunTimes
methods.description: Moves the current run start time forward to prepare for the next synchronization window.

methods.name: setSplitStartTime
methods.description: Records the start time of the current data split for performance metrics.

methods.name: createInitialHistory
methods.description: Creates an initial synchronization history record before starting data transfer, marking the process as running.

methods.name: assembleValuesToCreate
methods.description: Collects new entity values created within the current window for synchronization.

methods.name: assembleValuesToStore
methods.description: Gathers existing entity values that have been updated within the current window for synchronization.

methods.name: assembleKeysToRemove
methods.description: Retrieves entity keys marked for removal during synchronization.

methods.name: saveResultsReportedFromDataStore
methods.description: Stores the results from data store operations, updates history, and performance metrics.

methods.name: saveFinalSyncResults
methods.description: Marks the synchronization as complete, updates status, and cleans up history if needed.

methods.name: makeEntityNameToUseSet
methods.description: Creates a set of entity names that are included in the synchronization process.

methods.name: makeEntityModelToUseList
methods.description: Builds the list of model entities to include in the sync, based on the configuration.

methods.name: getCurrentRunStartTime
methods.description: Determines the start time for the current sync window based on previous sync and entity data.

methods.name: saveSyncErrorInfo
methods.description: Records errors encountered during synchronization onto entities for monitoring and retry.

methods.name: runPushStartRunning
methods.description: Initiates a push synchronization process, marking the entity sync as running and creating initial history.

methods.name: setTotalRowCounts
methods.description: Sets counts of total entities to process in current split.

methods.name: runPushSendData
methods.description: Sends collected entity data to the target service for persistence, and updates counters.
